mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with three consecutive monthly FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending confidence and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by >0.3pp monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases above 4.0% and unemployment rate rises above 4.0% signal dual monetary tightening and labor market weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: dual monetary tightening and labor stress
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% annually), rising housing starts (HOUST) signal resilient consumer demand and economic strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and rising HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production decline below 108.0 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings visibility and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 108.0.

mechanism_narrative: In low-unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), rising payroll employment growth above 0.5% monthly signals strong labor market conditions and positive consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous consumer spending growth (RSAFS rising) and industrial production decline (INDPRO falling) indicate demand-supply mismatch, signaling economic instability and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS rises and INDPRO falls.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts decline exceeding 1.0% signals weakening residential construction, reducing economic activity confidence and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST falls by >1.0% monthly.
